Perfect! Both type checking and tests pass. The fix is complete.

## Summary

Fixed a pagination bug in `/app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` where the post list was skipping the first page. The issue was on line 16 where `page + 1` was being passed to the paginate method, causing an off-by-one error. Since the `ListPostsQuerySchema` validator already provides 1-indexed page numbers (with a default of 1), the code was incorrectly requesting page 2 when users accessed page 1. Changed `.paginate({ page: page + 1, perPage: 10 })` to `.paginate({ page, perPage: 10 })` so that page 1 now correctly shows the 10 newest posts instead of starting from the 11th newest post.
